research_question: Can a source-native incompressible three-dimensional PKLSA vortex produce a reproducible intrinsic scalar phase frequency without imposing the desired frequency or time-dilation law?
objective: A068 v0.2.0 validates the diagnostic method and upstream A064 provenance. It does not identify a physical clock from geometry-only A064; physical discovery awaits a separately frozen source-qualified dynamic campaign.
null_hypothesis: H0: Any apparent periodic phase may be due to rigid-body motion, beating, windowing, translation, instrumental/spectral choices, or nonconverged Euler dynamics. Preflight controls are not physical null rejection.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: A certified, materially bounded, source-native Euler vortex exhibits a coherent intrinsic phase that is stable under frame reduction, time/space/core convergence and independent operator prediction. This claim is not tested physically in v0.2.0.
assumptions: Incompressible inviscid Euler flow with no forcing; periodic Cartesian velocity inputs are separate from 3D KnotPlot carrier coordinates.
Synthetic sinusoidal controls test method implementation only, never an Euler or PKLSA physical prediction.
A064 v0.3.0 source is from a single KnotPlot geometry-only family, not a qualified independent PKLSA dynamics provider.
SST constants must not be used to fit a target frequency, and coordinate units may be non-SI.
The two enstrophy-covariance eigenvalue-gap signals are not independent physical clocks; their agreement is a weak necessary screen only.

symbols.meaning: simulation time in declared source units

equations.dimensional_check: Both acceleration and pressure-gradient / density have L T^-2.
Eigenvalues and trace of C have L^2; ratios dimensionless.
Hilbert transform and phase are dimensionless.

equations.purpose: Recover measured frequency from linear phase trend
equations.dimensional_check: Slope has T^-1; normalized source time cannot be reported as SI Hz.

observables.definition: q1 and q2 from distinct covariance gaps; correlated weak screen; no independent clock inference
Phase RMS residual and instantaneous-frequency coefficient of variation
Cross-frequency relative difference of q1 and q2

steps.operation: Verify user uploaded source hashes and method/simulation evidence classes exactly
Rerun positive sine, rigid rotation and beating null controls; cross-check archived preflight output
Assess availability of source-qualified materially bounded and temporally converged PKLSA velocity evolution (none provided)
Keep Euler linear/Floquet operator holdout noncertified until an actual relative-periodic background exists
Require C++ FP64 and optional SYCL numerical certification only on a physical, registered dataset
Require source independent replication and finite-core convergence in a later registered campaign

falsification_criteria.criterion: Any preflight source hash differs from frozen value
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: G1 FAIL: invalid evidence; downstream cannot run.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Positive known oscillator is not recovered within abs frequency 1e-5 simulation inverse-time or any negative-control false-pass
No materially bounded 3D PKLSA trajectory with independent numerical/physical qualification exists
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: G3 UNRESOLVED: physical hypothesis not tested.

falsification_criteria.criterion: In a future separately frozen physical campaign, registered candidate frequency loses coherence after spatial/core/time refinement
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: FAIL for registered model instance after appropriate source certification.

edge_cases: Rigid-body rotation without internal shape change; Hilbert edge transients; nonuniform time; near-degenerate covariance eigenvalues; beating; phase unwrapping; unregistered mask; whole-box enstrophy; nonstationary Euler linearization.
predictions: No intrinsic frequency can be inferred from static geometry.
A genuine candidate must provide measurable phase recurrence in source-native Euler evolution with admissible material support.
A true Kelvin/Floquet frequency prediction must not be selected after inspecting phase-fit results.
